entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I bought this... uh... VeloBand Pulse thing? It's not working. I'm just so confused by it all.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I don't know, it's just... it seems like garbage. The heart rate is wrong, I think. Honestly, I don't have time to figure it all out. Can't you just help me? I just want my money back.
I understand you're frustrated and want a quick resolution. We do have a technical support team that can walk through some quick troubleshooting steps. It usually only takes a few minutes.
No, no, I'm not good with that stuff. It's just too overwhelming. I don't want to try and fix it, I just want a refund. The website didn't explain any of this.
Okay, I understand. Let me check the return eligibility for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think it's VF88602. Is that right? I get so lost with all these numbers.
No problem at all, let me pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago.
Right, yes. Is that a problem? I hope it's not too late.
Let me just check our policy... one moment. Okay, yes. According to my system, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh! So... I can return it? For a full refund?
That's correct. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the device back at our warehouse, you'll see the full refund processed. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
